name: B10-0144/2026 (S&D) – Four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to give Ukraine much more military support, including air defence systems, long-range weapons and artillery ammunition. It wants stronger economic pressure on Russia to stop the war, and it says Russia must pay for the damage it caused. It also asks that remaining limits on how Western weapons sent to Ukraine may be used against military targets in Russia be lifted. This is the Parliament's position and request; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks for more weapons and joint buying for Ukraine; EU governments decide.
- It wants frozen Russian money used to back a loan for Ukraine's defence and rebuilding.
- It urges EU countries to lift limits on Western weapons hitting targets inside Russia.
